text:
Maria Chen: kicking off security baseline for the new eu3-gpu cluster bring-up. want to lock IAM roles, secret handling, KMS/HSM flow, and a policy-validation checklist before handoff to Sec. tagging @Alex and @Ranjit for infra + crypto. goal: validated in 48h and then handoff.
Alex T.: ok - high level: 1) service roles (node, scheduler, metrics) 2) KMS CMK per-tenant if required, otherwise cluster CMK with strict key policy 3) secrets in Vault/SSM with KMS wrapping 4) network endpoints only (no public s3).
Ranjit Singh: for HSM/KMS: prefer cloud-managed HSM for now (AWS CloudHSM or GCP HSM). need key rotation policy (90d), key admin principals limited to `redwood-kms-admins` group, and a usage policy that denies raw key export. example AWS CLI to create CMK:
```
aws kms create-key --description "eu3-gpu-cluster-cmk" --tags TagKey=cluster,TagValue=eu3-gpu
```
and set alias:
```
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/eu3-gpu-cluster --target-key-id <key-id>
```
Samir Patel: secrets: we'll use Vault with KMS auto-unseal (HSM backed). Kubernetes secret encryption at rest should be enabled using the KMS key. quick kube config snippet:
```
apiVersion: apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1
kind: EncryptionConfiguration
resources:
  - resources:
    - secrets
    providers:
    - kms:
        name: aws-kms
        endpoint: unix:///var/run/kms-plugin/socket
```
Alex T.: IAM role names + minimal policies (suggested):
- `eu3-node-role` -> EC2/GCE instance profile, restrict to ENI/spot controls, no s3:* wildcard
- `eu3-controller-sa` -> restrict to secrets:get, kms:Decrypt on the cluster CMK
- `eu3-metrics` -> read-only CloudWatch/Stackdriver
Attach policy samples to infra ticket. keep permissions principled (deny broad iam:PassRole except for a small ops team).
Kevin Liu: networking/cost notes: enforce VPC endpoints for storage and kms endpoints. enable route table egress rules to block public internet except for approved registries. cost-wise reserve a 20% buffer for initial autoscaling (we spin up +10 GPUs for canary). tag all resources: cost-center:redwood-inference, env:staging|prod.
infra-bot: quota-check-runner: eu3 GPU quota available=38, requested reservation=10, remaining after reservation=28. created ticket INFRA-5123 for quota bump if needed.
Ranjit Singh: HSM procurement note: if customer requires FIPS/HSM, we need to request HSM cluster and schedule 2-week lead time. for initial prod we do CMK with CloudHSM backing if necessary.
Samir Patel: also add secret scanning in CI (truffleHog or gitleaks) and runtime secret exposure checks (Falco) as a blocking check before handoff.
Alex T.: policy checks to run pre-handoff: `tfsec` for infra, `kube-bench` for control plane config, `conftest` with OPA policies for our kube manifests. example run:
```
make infra-check && tfsec infra/ && kube-bench --config-dir=./kube-bench-config
```
Maria Chen: action items: 1) Alex: produce IAM policy snippets + open PR for infra terraform (owner: 24h) 2) Ranjit: KMS/HSM config + key policy draft (owner: 24h) 3) Samir: Vault auto-unseal + k8s encryption config (owner: 36h) 4) Kevin: network egress rules + tagging enforcement (owner: 24h) 5) infra-bot created quota ticket. we'll reconvene pass/fail checks in 48h and then schedule Sec handoff. please reply with :thumbsup: or concerns.
Kevin Liu: :thumbsup: tagging cost/team leads for awareness.
Alex T.: lgtm, will link PR once ready.
Ranjit Singh: one concern: service account impersonation - add an explicit deny in KMS policy for `sts:AssumeRole` except from `infra-ci` principal.
Samir Patel: quick note: put a read-only KMS key for monitoring to avoid exposing decryption ops to monitoring stack.
sec-bot: Scheduled policy scan queued: tfsec run scheduled in 4 hours, kube-bench scheduled in 6 hours. results will post here.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone — I'll post final pre-handoff checklist here once scans are done. if anything blocks, escalate in this thread.
